scores.description: Exactly N direct-suitability scores in candidate order; scores[i] applies to candidate[i]. 0.75-1.0 = directly/closely satisfies the whole request; 0.45-0.74 = meaningful partial fit; 0.15-0.44 = incidental overlap only; 0.0-0.14 = no meaningful fit. Penalize missing central requested concept even when a secondary attribute matches. Length must equal candidate count.
